Why it matters here The harness both validates task instances and grades patches, so a silent reversal can mark a correct fix as failing and can affect which instances pass validation. Because upstream SWE-bench already fixed this, syncing would also keep the two harnesses consistent. Suggested fix Upstream SWE-bench changed this chain on 9 August 2026 in 6cd91d8 : it adds git apply --verbose --3way , uses patch --batch --forward --fuzz=5 -p1 -i , and restores a clean tree ( git checkout -- . ; git clean -fd ) before each fallback attempt. Porting that change should remove the problem. If your environment keeps setup edits as uncommitted changes, reset to that prepared state rather than to HEAD . Happy to help test a fix.
